name: turftimer-mcp-server
description: TurfTimer read-only MCP server (Phase 1). Reads Firestore with the caller's Firebase ID token so firestore.rules enforce access.

scripts.test:emulator: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cd ../firestore-tests && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-turftimer-mcp "cd ../mcp-server && node --test build/test/emulator.test.js"
